meta.title: Hollis Dental | Family dentist in Stoke Newington
meta.description: Family dental practice on Church Street, Stoke Newington. NHS and private check-ups, hygiene, white fillings, Invisalign and same day emergency appointments.

rationale: A Swiss poster treatment gives nervous patients something orderly to look at: one red signal colour, big grotesque type, numbered rows and nothing that moves unexpectedly. The numbered treatment index and the step row make the practice feel predictable, and the 10am rule is shown as a plain fact. The tooth-and-clock drawing is the one piece of personality, drawn for this practice only.

props.headline: Hollis Dental
facts: Emergencies seen the same day if you call before 10am

items.name: Check-ups
items.description: NHS or private. A look, a clean chat about what you see, and a plan you agree to before anything starts.

items.name: Hygiene
items.description: Appointments with one of our two hygienists. Gentle scaling and polish, and we stop whenever you raise a hand.

items.name: White fillings
items.description: Tooth coloured fillings that match the tooth next to them.

items.name: Invisalign
items.description: Clear aligners for adults and teenagers. Ask for a consultation to see if they suit you.

items.name: Emergencies
items.description: Toothache, a broken tooth, a lost filling. Call before 10am and we see you that day.

props.caption: Call before this and your emergency appointment is today.

steps.name: Call or book online
steps.detail: Tell us if you are nervous. We note it on your file so every person you meet already knows.

steps.name: Sit and talk
steps.detail: Nothing happens in the chair until you have said what worries you.

steps.name: Look first
steps.detail: The dentist explains what they see and what it would cost on the NHS or privately.

steps.name: You decide
steps.detail: Treat today, come back, or go home and think. All three are fine.

props.caption: One tooth, one clock. Call before ten.
